cues: If the galvanometer deflects the same way at both ends of the wire, there is no balance point.
Either the driver cell's e m f is too small, smaller than the one you are measuring, or a cell has been connected the wrong way round.
Always make E nought bigger than E, and join both positive terminals to the same end.
text: One practical trap. If the galvanometer deflects the same way at both ends of the wire, there is no balance point. Either the driver cell's e m f is too small, smaller than the one you are measuring, or a cell has been connected the wrong way round. Always make E nought bigger than E, and join both positive terminals to the same end.
